planets.name: WASP-11 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-11 with a 3.72-day year, found in 2008.

text.card: WASP-11 b was found in 2008 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-11. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2008, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.72247975, pl_radj 1.11, pl_bmassj 0.79

quotes.title: WASP-11b
quotes.card: WASP-11b/HAT-P-10b or WASP-11Ab/HAT-P-10Ab is an extrasolar planet discovered in 2008.
quotes.introduction: The discovery was announced by press release by the SuperWASP project in April 2008 along with planets WASP-6b through to WASP-15b, however at this stage more data was needed to confirm the parameters of the planets and the coordinates were not given.
